title: Nurit N
content: I was a healthy young woman when I went into labor. From my previous birth experience, I knew how difficult it could be. So, I chose to have both, my pregnancy and delivery, overseen by a gynecologist who was also a surgeon. My labor pains began around midnight. When the doctor arrived, he administered Pitocin several times. Later, we learned this caused my womb to rupture in five places during delivery. I began to bleed heavily, but thankfully, my baby girl was delivered safely. However, the doctor couldn’t identify the source of my severe bleeding. He attempted a cervical suturing procedure, but that also tore, and the bleeding continued. From 3:00 AM to 7:00 AM, I was losing a dangerous amount of blood despite transfusions. When the nurses changed shifts, the incoming nurse took over my case and she saved my life. I was rushed into the emergency surgery room, surrounded by professors and doctors who were urgently called into the hospital. During the surgery, I had an experience. I remember every detail of that moment as vividly as if it happened yesterday. The memory was strong and real. I felt my soul leave my body and float away. I entered a place filled with welcoming, warm light, full of colors like a bright sunset. I felt more love, peace, and happiness than I ever knew was possible. I felt pure, unconditional love with no expectations, no religion, and no obligations. There was only acceptance. I felt as light as a butterfly, floating freely in an open space beyond time and place. I was like air; something you can’t see or smell, only feel. What I felt was the energy and love all around me. The atmosphere was calm and serene, even though my physical body was in crisis. Then, I was pulled like a magnet into a dark gray cloud, where I saw other souls moving together in a circle. We all moved in perfect order, one after another, like air. There were many clouds, each with souls moving in circles. Sometimes, I saw a soul fall back down to earth. Even though I felt happier and more peaceful than ever before, I wanted to return to my body. I fought hard to leave the circle and go back to my newborn baby and my young daughter at home. When I came back, my life changed completely. I saw everything differently. My purpose became clear, I lost my fear of death, and I felt a much stronger spiritual connection. I left my successful job, started my own business, and divorced my abusive husband. Dying felt like truly waking up.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Childbirth, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, Yes, my level of consciousness and alertness during the experience was very different from my normal, everyday state. Everything was crystal clear—my thoughts and feelings were easy to understand, with no confusion or distractions like I usually have in daily life. I felt a deep sense of clarity and awareness. Most importantly, I realized that everyone is truly a soul, and at that level, we are all the same—there are no differences between us.
elements.At what time during the experience were: During the NDE, I was totally conscious and alert.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Before my experience, my vision was just like anyone else's. I saw through my eyes, limited by direction, lighting, and what was physically in front of me. I accepted mental abuse as if it were okay, I hated myself, I judged people harshly, and I was basically not a happy person. I worked in a job I despised and could only see what was outside me such as shapes, people, and places. But during my experience, my way of seeing completely changed. I wasn't seeing through my eyes anymore because my soul was taking over. I could see emotions, meanings, and energies, not just physical forms. Since then, I see this life differently. Earthly sight feels dimmer, like a fog compared to the clarity I had there. I quit my job and opened my own business, then I divorced my mentally abusive husband. That vision stays with me in my heart. It is more real than anything else I've known.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: All my senses were focused and sharpened during the experience, unlike my everyday senses which weren't as sharp.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, The colors I saw were indescribable, like a sunset but brighter and stronger. I still look for similar colors on earth.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, The light had bright sunset colors and was warm with unconditional love and peace surrounding me. I remember floating lightweight and happy, like a butterfly. I floated into open space outside of time and place. Everything felt like air. It was invisible but filled with energy and love.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Unconditional love, joy, peace, and happiness.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Jewish, I never practiced the Jewish religion at home as a child. We believed in God, but my mom and dad never practiced religion at home.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, Before my experience, I had no specific beliefs and never thought about life's meaning on Earth. I was a good, kind woman who helped others whenever I could.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, My beliefs now include the afterlife, unconditional love, helping others, and soul equality. These create a positive and meaningful approach to life, emphasizing connection, compassion, and inherent worth in every individual.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I heard a voice I could not identify, During my experience, I heard a voice, but it wasn't like hearing with my ears. It felt like the voice came from inside me and all around me at once. I understood it completely. The voice was calm, wise, full of love and without any judgment. It didn’t sound like regular speech but felt like a deep message I could sense with my whole being. It was like guidance filled with wisdom, energy, and care. Some might call it God or a Higher Self. To me, it felt like pure truth and unconditional love. I also felt a clear agreement that if I was returning, that meant I had a mission to fulfill in this life. My mission is to help others.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Absolutely! We are all souls, and our bodies serve us in this lifetime. I believe there’s a deep, mystical awareness. It is a universal connection that binds us together as souls.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, Yes, the NDE showed me that struggles are opportunities for growth, for the soul to evolve, and for us to become more compassionate toward others and toward ourselves. There was no blame or shame, just deep understanding.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Yes, during my experience, I felt a deep, clear understanding about the meaning and purpose of life on Earth. I realized that life isn't just about achievements or material things. Life is about love, growth, connection, and the impact we have on each other. Each person has a unique light and reason for being here. Even small actions motivated by kindness, compassion, and creativity can have great meaning. I understood that we're all connected, and that our souls are here to learn, to heal, and to help others grow. Nothing is wasted, not even our pain. Everything we go through is part of a bigger journey. I came back knowing that life has deep purpose, even when we can't see it at the moment.
Yes, Absolutely! I saw souls occasionally falling from clouds onto earth; it felt like they were being reborn into the world.

Yes, Yes, during my NDE, I became aware that the difficulties and challenges we face in earthly life are not meaningless. I saw that our hardships are part of a bigger process. Each one has purpose, even when it feels painful or unfair. I understood that the pain we experience is seen and known, and that we're never truly alone in it. On a soul level, the hard moments help shape who we're becoming. We are not punished; they are part of the journey.
Yes, Unconditional love, no matter who you are or where you come from.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: This experience gave me the courage I needed to change my life. I left a stable, well-paying job, started my own business, and finally had the strength to divorce my emotionally abusive husband. As an artist, I still have a powerful goal: to create a special collection that brings messages that may help lost souls on Earth.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, After my experience, I divorced.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, This experience became emotional for me, and I couldn't talk about it for many years. I now understand that it is my destiny and my duty to pass on my afterlife experience and my understanding from that experience.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I remember every detail of my experience. I recall the experience with great clarity and detail, as if it were happening right now, although it was over 40 years ago.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, My gifts from this experience are energy, power, and self-esteem.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I didn't need to believe that the experience was real or not. I feel it, remember it clearly, every moment of my life. It's part of me now.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I feel it, remember it clearly, every moment of my life. It's part of me now.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, The feeling, voices I experienced there, and the urge to spread those messages to the world through my artistic talent.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, As I said before, my experience is part of me now and I remember every detail clearly as the day it happened.
